events.title: Maker Mondays - Learn about 3D Printing, Laser Cutting, Electronics and More!
events.description: A regular open night at Brisbane Makerspace for networking and sharing knowledge, featuring demonstrations of 3D printing, laser cutting, and electronics. It's an opportunity to meet like-minded individuals in the maker community.

events.title: A/pART Collective Collage Sessions
events.description: Relaxed fortnightly collage sessions where participants can meet others and engage in creative hands-on art. No experience is necessary, and guidance is provided for all attendees.

events.title: Brisbane Rotary Art Show
events.description: The 44th annual art show, showcasing works by prominent and emerging Australian artists. Proceeds from this large exhibition support Youngcare, Coffee Brigade, and other Rotary community projects.

events.title: QPAC Discovery Tour
events.description: A behind-the-scenes tour of the Queensland Performing Arts Centre, offering an immersive look into Queensland's rich performing arts culture and history.

events.title: Cribb Island: Brisbane's Lost Suburb (Exhibition)
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane City Hall
events.description: An exhibition at the Museum of Brisbane exploring the fascinating history and cultural significance of Cribb Island, Brisbane's 'lost suburb', which was a thriving community before its eventual demolition.

events.title: Book Club | Brisbane Working Holiday Girls
events.location: My Beer Dealer - Alfred St Bar & Bottlo, Fortitude Valley
events.description: A book club meeting designed for discussion, book-themed games, and social icebreakers, including an activity to create bracelets and phone charms. Aims to help attendees meet fellow book lovers and make new friends.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour: Seeing Art, Seeing Ourselves (GOMA)
events.description: A free guided tour at the Gallery of Modern Art, led by volunteers, focusing on exploring how art reflects and informs our understanding of ourselves and society.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour: Seeing Art, Seeing Ourselves (QAG)
events.description: A free guided tour at the Queensland Art Gallery, led by volunteers, exploring how artistic works can offer insights into ourselves and broader human experience.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour: Collection Snapshot (QAG)
events.description: A concise, free guided tour at the Queensland Art Gallery, providing a quick overview of highlights from the QAG collection for those seeking a brief cultural engagement.
